text: Einklang
Blazing Graben
Klaspe Slum
Pelulu
Yungo
Iconos
Cannot go to another map during the battle!
The map is under construction.\nPlease wait for the update.
BOSS BATTLE\nDefeat Iconos!!
Oh, my, gosh! What is this?!\nMost of them are broken!!
The automated cannons for defense are destroyed...
Hey, are you repairing the cannons all alone?
Ya. I'm Yungo. He's Iconos...\nMy dad was doing this job recently but he was\ninjured by monsters.
So, I'm repairing them for my dad.\nPeople in the town is relying on robots and\ndo nothing.
I bet they don't know the cannons are broken.
Warning. Warning.\nTwo unidentified persons approaching.
Whoa?!
It's alright, Iconos. They came from the town,\nright? They haven't unsheathed the weapons, so\nthey are not dangerous. Withdraw warnings.
Your legs...
Yes. I was attacked by monsters around two years\nago, I guess. And I can't walk since then.\nNow Iconos is my legs.
Iconos can't talk but he understands what I want\nto do and what I want to say...\nHe's one of my important friends.
Oh, such an idiot. I often see this kind of\npeople. They empathize golems and treat them\nlike real friends!
You have to say it?!\nIconos has feelings! He's special!!
Hm? Is it...

Warning! Warning!

Unidentified flying object approaching fast!!
10 o'clock!
Ugh!!
Iconos! What's wrong?!\nIt's me! Don't you remember?!
No target to protect. The unidentified objects\nhave been broken. However, weapons and multiple\nlife forms detected. Destroy mode activated.
It's gonna crush him!\nBeat the golem down and stop it!
Please! Don't hurt Iconos any more!!
No! Completely stop it!!
Excellent job...\nThe golem was identifying you as a target to\nprotect with the emblem.
You became a target to destroy since the emblem\ncame off, so we had to stop it to save you...
Why... Why did you hurt my friend?!
We didn't hurt it, we broke it!
Listen. Humans have lots of defects and robots\nare created by humans. No wonder they sometimes\nharm humans with malfunctions.
We were attacked by a metal that we can't\nunderstand each other. We had no other option\nthan break it down to protect ourselves!
But, Iconos understands me.\nHe has feelings! So, you didn't have to...
Nah, it's just imagination.\nRobots are made of metal, and there's no heart\nin it.
They do not have feelings.\nThey are dolls that follow programs.\nYou can't trust them!!
You wanna be a full-fledged Technista, right?\nThen, you should consider about the relationships\nbetween humans and robots with this opportunity.
Sounds like Pelulu is right but...\nIsn't it too much for Yungo...
You have something against golems?\nNo, well... I couldn't help it cuz he was too\nsofty for a Technista...
...I picked up a golem during travel long ago.\nIt was obedient and protected me from monsters,\nso I was trusting it but...
It was programed to make me trust it.\nIt ran away when I left my important money.
Then, I've learned a lesson.\nThere's no place for feelings in dealing with\nrobots...
Robots can have feelings...\nIt's impossible but sometimes people want to\nbelieve so...
Since Pelulu was hurt, she might have keener eyes\nfor the relationships between humans and robots\nthan Yungo's...
For now, let's go back to the town!\nBut... How can we carry it?
[Looks like Iconos is moving a bit differently than\nbefore...]
Excellent. You turned off the autonomous circuit.\nYou're right. The robot has to be treated as the\nsubstitute of your legs.
Shut up. It's because his engine hasn't been\ncompletely recovered.
I'll restart it in a while, so why not shut\nyour mouth?
Hey! Are you gonna activate the circuit again?!\nYou had such a dangerous experience.\nWhy are you...
W-What's that?!
Whoaaa! Help meeee!\nIconooooos!!
W-Whaaaaat?!\nThe circuit was turned off!!
